fields.statement: Re-ran at c0b0739 in a detached worktree with RHIZA_* unset; all pass. review-signoff.txtar: rhiza run start stops with current signoff, signoff_waiting true, detail waiting for the owner's sign-off; rhiza run approve prints approved by the actor, run succeeded, run status --json signoffs entry {actor test, outcome approved, rule owner, step signoff, visit 1}, change set stays draft. Outside a waiting review run both run approve and run request-changes exit 2 with no run, a run stopped at wait step ci (journal line count unchanged), and a finished run. review-signoff-changes.txtar: check alpha ran cycles 1, 2 and 3 (cap used); run request-changes with one finding on leaf thing starts role=fixer cycle=4 leaf=thing findings=yes, then its verifier, then only alpha re-runs; the fix commit carries Leaf: thing; the run is stopped with signoff_waiting true and next approve; a third visit is refused exit 2 over max_visits. review-signoff-autonomous.txtar: --autonomous run succeeds, signoff passes approved by rule autonomous, journal signoff entry has rule autonomous and no actor. describe-golden.txtar passes and lists run.approve, run.request-changes, signoffs and signoff_waiting. Unit tests TestSignoff* (internal/run), TestSignoffStep* (internal/workflow), TestSignoffLine (internal/api) pass; go test ./... passes.
fields.tests: env -u RHIZA_CHANGE -u RHIZA_ACTOR -u RHIZA_FOR -u RHIZA_RUN -u RHIZA_SESSION -u RHIZA_ROOT go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/review-signoff' -v -count=1; same env: go test ./internal/run -run TestSignoff -v -count=1; go test ./internal/workflow -run TestSignoffStep -v -count=1; go test ./internal/api -run TestSignoffLine -v -count=1; go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/describe-golden' -count=1; go test ./... -count=1.
